name: @pipeworx/mcp-traveltime

tools.name: traveltime_isochrone
tools.description: What area is reachable within N minutes by public transport (or driving/walking/cycling) from a point (isochrone / travel-time polygon). Unlike road-only routing, this supports public_transport. Returns the reachable-area polygon(s). Example: traveltime_isochrone({ lat: 51.5072, lon: -0.1276, travel_time: 30, minutes: true, transport: "public_transport", departure_time: "2026-07-06T08:30:00Z", _apiKey: "appId:apiKey" })

travel_time.description: Max journey time. Seconds by default (default 1800 = 30 min). Set minutes:true to pass minutes instead. Max 14400s / 240 min.

minutes.description: If true, travel_time is interpreted as minutes and multiplied by 60.

transport.description: Transport mode (default "public_transport"). One of: driving, walking, cycling, public_transport, driving+public_transport.

departure_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of departure (e.g. "2026-07-06T08:30:00Z"). Departure-based isochrone: area reachable leaving at this time.

arrival_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of arrival. Arrival-based isochrone: area from which you can arrive by this time. If set, overrides departure_time. Public-transport isochrones need one of departure_time/arrival_time.

_apiKey.description: TravelTime credentials as "appId:apiKey" from your traveltime.com account.

tools.name: traveltime_time_filter
tools.description: Which of these locations are reachable within N minutes from an origin by public transport (or driving/walking/cycling), and how long each takes. Filters candidate destinations by travel time. Example: traveltime_time_filter({ origin_lat: 51.5072, origin_lon: -0.1276, destinations: [{ id: "a", lat: 51.52, lon: -0.09 }, { id: "b", lat: 51.60, lon: -0.20 }], travel_time: 45, minutes: true, transport: "public_transport", departure_time: "2026-07-06T08:30:00Z", _apiKey: "appId:apiKey" })

destinations.description: Candidate destinations to test. Each: { id?, lat, lon }. Max 2000. IDs auto-generated ("dest_0", ...) if omitted.

travel_time.description: Max journey time. Seconds by default (default 1800 = 30 min). Set minutes:true to pass minutes. Max 14400s / 240 min.

minutes.description: If true, travel_time is interpreted as minutes and multiplied by 60.

transport.description: Transport mode (default "public_transport"). One of: driving, walking, cycling, public_transport, driving+public_transport.

departure_time.description: ISO 8601 departure timestamp (e.g. "2026-07-06T08:30:00Z"). Public-transport searches need a timestamp; defaults to now if omitted.

_apiKey.description: TravelTime credentials as "appId:apiKey" from your traveltime.com account.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-traveltime forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the traveltime pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
